subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I don't know which career he will choose. He __delays making strong decisions__.

options.text: is as clean as a whistle

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"sits on the fence"** means to delay making a decision when you have to choose between two sides in an argument or a competition. (निर्णय लेने में देरी करना)

 
 
• **Example:** When asked whether he supports the new policy, he just **sits on the fence **and avoids giving a clear answer.
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is **"I don't know which career he will choose. He sits on the fence."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **is as clean as a whistle** (बिल्कुल साफ): Used to describe something that is very clean or clear.

 
 
• **Example:** The kitchen was **as clean as a whistle** after the thorough cleaning.
 
 
 
• **turns a blind eye** (अनदेखा करना): To deliberately ignore something.
 
 
• **Example:** She **turns a blind eye** to the mistakes of her favorite employees.
 
 
 
• **spills the beans** (रहस्य खोल देना): To reveal secret information.
 
 
• **Example:** He **spilled the beans** about the new project ahead of the official announcement.
